dimensions_status: Plant distributions, asset dimensions, densities, slope limits and setbacks are design choices, not surveyed plants or species. Cover comes from attributed OSM geometry; heights are sampled by native PCG from the LiDAR-derived Landscape.
ownership_policy: Each mask's final row and column are zero; neighboring tiles own the corresponding first edge. Half-cell seam margin is explicit, avoiding duplicate instances.
cover_priority: forest first, scrub second, meadow last: explicit clearings override overlapping forest polygons
